name: Hotel Plopsaland
description: The official on-site hotel at Plopsaland De Panne, themed around the park's beloved characters. Perfect for families wanting to be steps from the rides.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room for up to 4 guests with character theming.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate sleeping areas for kids and parents.

statusNote: Plopsa's own site now lists the on-site hotel as 'Plopsaland Theater Hotel' (opened 1 Apr 2021, called 'Plopsa Hotel' by Freizeitpark-Welt), so the name 'Hotel Plopsaland' looks outdated.

name: Camping Plopsaland
description: A fun and affordable camping option adjacent to the park, with glamping pods and pitches for tents and caravans. Great for budget-conscious families.

rooms.name: Glamping Pod
rooms.description: Cosy furnished pod sleeping up to 4 with electricity and heating.

rooms.name: Camping Pitch
rooms.description: Standard pitch for tent or caravan with access to shared facilities.

statusNote: The campsite is now called 'Plopsaland Basecamp' (pitches for tents, caravans, mobile homes; Eurocampings lists it open 1 Jan-31 Dec), not 'Camping Plopsaland'.
statusSource: plopsa.com/en/plopsaland-basecamp/pitches and plopsa.com FAQ (fetched 23 Oct 2026); eurocampings.co.uk Plopsaland Basecamp listing
